long_biography.plain_text:
The Claremont name has anchored Parvinder Chopra's hotel and property activities in several markets. A Singapore company in which he was sole shareholder owned a Little India hotel. In France, he manages separate Claremont hotel and property companies in Cannes and Mougins, combining accommodation with the acquisition and management of real estate.

Chopra also chairs Venue C, a Cannes business that organises private and public events. His French company roles date from at least 2008 and now cover accommodation, property management and event organisation. The portfolio has kept him directly involved with buildings used for stays, investment and gatherings.
